answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a physically unclonable spectral fingerprint, much as velvet canopy signature resolved through a narrow inlet of red-edge bands that a willow shadow cannot spoof. Validators cross-check thermal infrared evapotranspiration residuals against chlorophyll fluorescence inversion, so duplicate agents collapse into one radiometric cluster. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
